title: teucrium trifoliatum
intro: Teucrium trifoliatum, commonly known as Germander, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Germander include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit hepatoprotective properties, making it a potential treatment for liver diseases. The bioactive constituents of Teucrium trifoliatum include diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
